text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New Year's Day—truly, the dawn of a new 
era.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Now for a quiz!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Riding in the car with Cesario, we arrived 
at a coast bathed in the beautiful morning 
sun.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The spotlighted Tiara Umamusume: Line 
Craft, Daring Heart, and Air Messiah."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Following their success in the Junior 
Class, these Umamusume are currently 
attracting an immense amount of attention—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Having steadily proven her ability with 2 
wins out of 3 races, who is the Umamusume 
polishing her form with fire in her heart 
for the upcoming Oka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And to pass the time until sunrise, the 
two of us were quizzing each other."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I remember correctly, Daring Heart has 
1 win in 3 starts, while Air Messiah has 1 
win in 1 start. Which means—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That is correct!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, next is my turn," I say, 
leaning forward. Why were the two of us at 
the beach in the first place—? It all 
started a few days ago with a proposal 
from Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There's a coast where the first sunrise of 
the year looks beautiful. I usually go 
with my family, but... would you like to 
join me?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have already received permission 
from my parents.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The light at dawn is magical. I truly want 
you to see it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing no reason to refuse, then, the two 
of us got in the car and came along."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Wait—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pointing toward the eastern sky. Squinting 
ahead—the dawn's first light!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Such a breathtaking view—a gasp of awe 
escaped my lips. Across the dark sea, 
streaks of gold danced and raced ahead.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. I'm glad it didn't cloud over.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario gave a shy smile as I thanked her 
for letting me see such a beautiful view.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's a view I love so much. It feels like 
it gives me a push into the beginning of 
the new year, so I wanted to share it with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Above all, I suppose I just like you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look up once more at the scenery gifted 
to me. The breathtaking view she prepared.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling our hearts wrapped in warmth— the 
two of us spent a while soaking in the 
morning glow.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: So... what should we do next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I hadn't made any particular 
plans. Turning it over in my mind, I 
recalled there was a fairly large shrine 
nearby.
choice_data_list: Want to try going to the shrine?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: A shrine visit? Sounds lovely!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... you must be tired, Trainer. 
You'll have to drive on the way back too, 
so maybe taking a short break would be a 
good idea.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
When I come with my family, we relax a bit 
at a nearby hot spring facility.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Or if you want a lighter break, there's a 
cafe with a lovely atmosphere, or..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's going to let me choose. In 
that case—
choice_data_list: No, I'm fine. Let's head to the shrine!

Let's take a break at the hot spring 
facility!
Shall we go check out the cafe!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Umm, the way to the shrine 
is...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, alright. Sorry to keep you 
waiting."
choice_data_list:
You were really passionate about it, 
weren't you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Since she's entering the Classic year... I 
prayed that she will overcome everything 
smoothly and without incident.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, since we're here, would you 
like to buy a protective charm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the amulet counter, a colorful 
assortment of various amulets was neatly 
arranged.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of pattern would Cesario like... 
Probably something simple and calm. I pick 
one up.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sounds nice. Well then, let's 
take this—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...? Did I say anything about a "victory 
charm"?
choice_data_list:
...Now that you mention it, maybe I didn't 
say that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She hadn't said anything, but somehow I 
was convinced of it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...So you figured it out? Hehe, 
honestly...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Um, excuse me. One of these, please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a peaceful New Year's Day, where 
both mind and body were able to relax 
together with Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The intermission is short. The Classic 
year will pass without a moment to catch 
one's breath. I offered another prayer to 
the now fully risen New Year's sun, hoping 
she would make it through safely.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...! In that case, allow me to 
guide you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In addition to free-flowing natural hot 
springs, this inn also offers fruit baths 
that change with the seasons.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
They have such a wide variety of open-air 
baths here... Mom and I stayed in for so 
long that we gave Dad quite a hard time.
choice_data_list: You really are knowledgeable, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's our usual yearly spot, after 
all. As for a hot spring you might like, 
Trainer... Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, guided by Cesario, we entered a 
venerable hot spring inn—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was a wonderful bath.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to have kept you waiting. You 
haven't caught a chill after your bath, 
have you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Trainer... weren't you in the 
open-air bath the entire time?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I got a little dizzy from the 
hot bath, so I came out a bit early.
choice_data_list: No, I was able to relax, so I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, the open-air bath felt so 
amazing that I spent almost the entire 
time outside.
choice_data_list: No, I was able to relax, so I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Oh, by the way, do you like 
fruit milk?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see. I had hoped you might enjoy the 
public baths a bit longer, but... As long 
as you had a good time, that's what 
counts.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's not really an apology, but... Um... 
it's super delicious, so it's my treat.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Next time you come, let's definitely check 
out some other hot springs. We can tour 
them together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fruit milk she handed over with a 
slightly apologetic look was refreshingly 
sweet and utterly delicious...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I drank the recommended fruit 
milk with Cesario. It had a refreshing 
sweetness and was delicious...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a peaceful New Year's Day, where 
both mind and body were able to relax 
together with Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The intermission is short. The Classic 
year will pass without a moment to catch 
one's breath. I offered another prayer to 
the now fully risen New Year's sun, hoping 
she would make it through safely.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Well then, allow me to guide 
you♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I like its unique atmosphere. They sell a 
few knick-knacks, too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The coffee here is delicious... Oh, but 
you might also like this limited-time 
special, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I consulted Cesario for her 
opinion while ordering drinks and light 
snacks.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Last weekend...? If I remember correctly, 
I baked some sweets."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I made a spinach and carrot cake for 
Craft.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And then, we finished it all in no time. 
Hehe...♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing you eat with so much relish makes 
cooking it all the more worthwhile... is 
what I was thinking."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
She shared her happiness with me. Kraft 
really is an amazing girl, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, I enjoyed breakfast while 
listening to Cesario talk about dorm life 
and all sorts of things happening at the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a peaceful New Year's Day, where 
both mind and body were able to relax 
together with Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The intermission is short. The Classic 
year will pass without a moment to catch 
one's breath. I offered another prayer to 
the now fully risen New Year's sun, hoping 
she would make it through safely.
